login.title: Sign in to online banking
login.subtitle: Customers and bank staff use the same sign-in. You'll land in the right portal for your role.
login.demoHint: Demo data only. Select a row to fill the form.
login.backendOffline: The banking server isn't reachable. If you're running locally, start the backend with Docker Compose and try again.

register.title: Open a current account
register.subtitle: We open a VND current account in your name as soon as you register. It starts with a zero balance.
register.usernameHint: 3–50 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
register.done: Your account is open. Welcome to SecureBank.

errors.username: Use 3–50 lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.password: The password doesn't meet all the requirements below.
errors.fullName: Enter your full name (up to 200 characters).

preview.note: This preview runs without a bank server. All names, balances and transfers are sample data kept in this browser tab.
preview.resetBody: All transfers, reviews and changes you made in this tab are discarded and the sample data is restored. You'll be signed out.

status.forbiddenTitle: This area isn't part of your access
status.forbiddenBody: Your role can't open this portal. If you think it should, ask an administrator.
status.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped.
status.recordMissingBody: It doesn't exist, or it isn't visible to you.
status.inProgress: This section is being built and arrives in the next preview update.

account.frozenNote: Frozen. Outgoing transfers are blocked; incoming transfers still arrive.

slip.title: Ledger slip · double entry
slip.noLines: No ledger lines: nothing was posted for this transaction.
slip.footer: Keep this slip for your records

flow.title: Money in and out
flow.chartAria: Money in and out per day over the last {{days}} days

dashboard.noAccountsBody: Your current account appears here as soon as it's opened.
dashboard.noActivityBody: Send your first one, or share your account number to receive money.

TRANSFER_REJECTED.title: Transfer not sent
TRANSFER_REJECTED.bodyTo: Your transfer of {{amount}} to {{party}} was rejected.

ACCOUNT_FROZEN.title: Account frozen
ACCOUNT_FROZEN.body: Account {{accountNumber}} is frozen. Outgoing transfers are blocked — contact the branch.
ACCOUNT_FROZEN.bodyNoNumber: Your account is frozen. Outgoing transfers are blocked — contact the branch.

ACCOUNT_UNFROZEN.title: Account active again
ACCOUNT_UNFROZEN.body: Account {{accountNumber}} is active again. You can send money as usual.
ACCOUNT_UNFROZEN.bodyNoNumber: Your account is active again. You can send money as usual.

WELCOME.title: Welcome to SecureBank
WELCOME.body: You're registered as {{username}}. Your VND current account is open.
WELCOME.bodyNoUser: Your VND current account is open.

notifications.subtitle: Notices about your transfers and accounts.
notifications.allMarked: All notices on this page are marked as read.
notifications.deliveryNote: Copies sent by email and SMS, for your records.
notifications.emptyBody: You'll get a notice here for every transfer in or out of your accounts.

ops.readOnly: Read-only access: your role can inspect but not change this record.

dashboard.title: Today at the bank
dashboard.subtitle: What needs a human decision right now, and how money moved today.
dashboard.queueEmptyBody: New alerts appear here as soon as the fraud rules flag a transfer.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Search by account number or customer name. Freezing blocks outgoing transfers only.

freeze.title: Freeze account
freeze.body: Outgoing transfers will be rejected until the account is unfrozen. Incoming transfers still arrive. The owner is notified.
freeze.unfreezeBody: The owner can send money again. The owner is notified.
freeze.reasonHint: Required, 3–255 characters. Recorded in the audit log.

limits.title: Transfer limits
limits.perAboveDaily: The per-transfer limit can't be higher than the daily limit.
limits.serverRule: Rejected by the server's limit rules.
limits.audited: Changes are recorded in the audit log with the old and new values.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Search by name, email or phone.
customers.empty: Try a shorter part of the name, email or phone.
customers.name: Customer
customers.noAlerts: No fraud alerts for this customer.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.subtitle: Every transfer in the bank, including rejected attempts.

recon.title: Reconciliation
recon.explain: Re-reads this transaction's ledger lines and checks that debits equal credits and the entry count matches the status.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details aren't valid. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.MALFORMED_REQUEST: The request couldn't be read. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN_OPERATION: Your role isn't allowed to do this.
errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.AUTH_USERNAME_TAKEN: This username is taken. Choose another.
errors.AUTH_LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: No account with this number. Check the digits.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_OWNED: This account isn't yours, so you can't send from it.
errors.ACCOUNT_FROZEN: This account is frozen. Outgoing transfers are blocked — contact the branch.
errors.ACCOUNT_CLOSED: This account is closed and can't send or receive money.
errors.ACCOUNT_STATUS_UNCHANGED: The account is already in that status.
errors.SAME_ACCOUNT_TRANSFER: You can't send money to the same account it comes from.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The two accounts use different currencies.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: Not enough money in the account for this amount.
errors.INVALID_TRANSFER_AMOUNT: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.TRANSFER_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This is above the per-transfer limit. Send a smaller amount.
errors.DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: This would go over today's transfer limit. Send less, or wait until tomorrow.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The transfer couldn't be identified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT: This submission was already used for a different transfer. Review the details and send again.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS: Your transfer is still being processed. Wait a moment before checking again.
errors.ACCOUNT_BUSY: Another transfer from this account is being processed. Try again in a moment — it's safe, you won't be charged twice.
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Someone else changed this record while you were editing. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
errors.FRAUD_ALERT_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find this fraud alert.
errors.FRAUD_ALERT_INVALID_TRANSITION: The alert can't move to that status from where it is now. Reload to see its current state.
errors.AUDIT_LOG_NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find this audit record.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: No connection to the bank. Check your network and try again.
errors.TIMEOUT: The bank took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE: The banking server isn't reachable right now. Try again shortly.

transfer.title: Send money
transfer.subtitle: Internal transfer between SecureBank accounts, in VND. Posted instantly.
transfer.noAccounts: You don't have an account to send from yet.
transfer.noAccountsBody: Once your current account is open, you can send money from here.
transfer.destinationHint: 10 digits. We'll show the holder's name so you can check it.
transfer.reviewNote: Nothing is sent until you confirm on the next step.
transfer.safetyBody: Make sure the holder name matches the person you expect. The bank will never ask you to move money to a "safe account".

errors.sourceRequired: Choose the account to send from.

review.title: Review transfer
review.subtitle: Check every line. Transfers can't be cancelled once posted.
review.sameKey: Retrying re-sends the same request with the same reference key, so the money can only move once.

receipt.title: Money sent to {{name}}
receipt.replayed: This is the original receipt for a request that had already been processed. No money moved a second time.

toast.sent: Sent. The ledger slip is below.
toast.rejected: The bank rejected this transfer. Nothing was debited.

transactions.title: Activity
transactions.subtitle: Every transfer in and out of your accounts. Rejected attempts appear only to the sender.
transactions.ledgerNote: Each posted transfer writes exactly two ledger lines: a debit on the sender and a credit on the beneficiary, for the same amount.
transactions.emptyFiltered: Try a wider date range or clear the filters.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Your current accounts, balances and passbooks.

statement.title: Passbook
statement.emptyBody: Movements appear here as soon as they're posted.
statement.note: Running balance after each entry. The opening balance was set when the account was opened; every movement since then is a ledger entry.

profile.title: Profile & security
profile.subtitle: Your customer details, how you're signed in, and display preferences.
profile.tokenNote: Your short-lived access token is kept only in this tab's memory. A refresh token in this tab's session storage keeps you signed in across reloads and is cleared when you sign out or close the tab.
profile.prefsNote: Amounts always use Vietnamese grouping (25.000.000 ₫); times are shown in Vietnam time (UTC+7).

fraud.title: Fraud queue
fraud.subtitle: Alerts raised by the rules engine. Highest risk first is one click away.
fraud.emptyBody: Clear the filters to see every alert.
fraud.scale: Scale: 0–29 low · 30–59 medium · 60–79 high · 80+ critical. An alert is raised from 30.

ruleDesc.HIGH_FREQUENCY: More than 5 outgoing transfers from this customer within 60 seconds.
ruleDesc.DAILY_VELOCITY: Customer's outgoing total today is above 200.000.000 ₫.
ruleDesc.NEW_BENEFICIARY: First transfer to this account, for 10.000.000 ₫ or more.

review.title: Review

hint.UNDER_REVIEW: You're looking into it; no note needed.
hint.REJECTED: Fraud confirmed. Consider freezing the account.

review.notePh: What did you check, and with whom?
review.noteRequired: A note is required for this decision.
review.terminal: This alert is closed. No further decisions are possible.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Append-only record of every security and financial event, from all services.
audit.subtitleStaff: Account, transaction and fraud events. User sign-in records and IP addresses are visible to auditors only.
audit.empty: Widen the date range or clear the filters.
audit.filterByCorrelation: Show every event of this request
audit.noChanges: This event carries no before/after data.
audit.appendOnly: Audit records can't be edited or deleted.
